camps.name: DC DPR Summer Camp 2026
camps.description: DC Department of Parks and Recreation full-day summer camp with four 2026 sessions: Jun 22-Jul 2, Jul 6-17, Jul 20-31, Aug 3-14. Lottery-based registration via DPRprograms.com; reduced rates available.

camps.name: DPR Winter Wondercamp
camps.description: DC Department of Parks and Recreation full-day camp for ages 6-12 during the DCPS winter break, built around DPR's "Move, Grow, and Be Green" philosophy. $40 per child per session, registration via DPRprograms.com.

camps.name: DPR Fun Day Camp
camps.description: DC Department of Parks and Recreation single-day camp for ages 6-12 offered on select DCPS full-day closures, with sports activities, arts and crafts and more. $10 per child per day for DC residents ($20 non-resident).

camps.name: Casper Summer Adventure Camp
camps.description: City of Casper Recreation Center action-packed summer adventure camp for kids ages 6-12 including swimming, activities and field trips. Full camp and weekly options; 5% discount for additional children (full camp only); campers receive an Aquatic Swim Pass valid Jun-Aug outside camp hours.

camps.name: Casper Super Fun Days & School Break Camps
camps.description: City of Casper Recreation Center camps for elementary-aged children during school breaks, with arts & crafts, sports, dance, ice skating and swimming. Holiday camp features swimming Tuesdays/Thursdays and skating other days.

camps.name: Casper Youth Leadership Camp
camps.description: City of Casper Recreation Center youth leadership camp (official camp paperwork page on the Casper Recreation Center site).

camps.name: Fargo Adaptive Camp-A-Day
camps.description: Fargo Parks day camp for individuals ages 6-18 with special needs (youth camp 6-12, teen camp 13-18), offering recreational opportunities that encourage social connection, at various park locations, Monday-Thursday in June and July.
